mapper.select: SELECT slot_id AS slotId, resource_id AS resourceId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, max_bookings AS maxBookings, status, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime, update_by AS updateBy, update_time AS updateTime FROM gym_time_slot WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE gym_time_slot SET current_bookings = #{currentBookings}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE slot_id = #{slotId}
mapper.select: SELECT slot_id AS slotId, resource_id AS resourceId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, max_bookings AS maxBookings, status, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime, update_by AS updateBy, update_time AS updateTime FROM gym_time_slot WHERE slot_id = #{slotId}

SELECT ts.slot_id AS slotId, ts.resource_id AS resourceId, ts.start_time AS startTime, ts.end_time AS endTime, ts.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, ts.max_bookings AS maxBookings, ts.status, ts.create_by AS createBy, ts.create_time AS createTime, ts.update_by AS updateBy, ts.update_time AS updateTime, IFNULL(r.count, 0) AS currentBookings FROM gym_time_slot ts LEFT JOIN ( SELECT slot_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM gym_reservation WHERE reservation_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY slot_id ) r ON ts.slot_id = r.slot_id WHERE ts.resource_id = #{resourceId}
